Repeat the correctness controls (SHA256(decompressed) == SHA256(generate_*_body)) with the same 4 auth states and 3 content types, but now through real CDN infrastructure with Accept-Encoding negotiation, CDN-specific headers (X-Cache, Via, ETag), and geographic latency.
